title: RNGdle Privacy Policy
description: Read the RNGdle privacy policy for this static browser game remake.
meta: Reviewed and updated by the RNGdle Editorial Team.

sections.heading: Local gameplay data
paragraphs: This static RNGdle remake stores gameplay state in the player's browser using localStorage. The saved data can include today's roll, matched badges, today's EP, and lifetime EP on the current device.
This data stays in the browser unless the player clears site data or uses the share button to copy or share a roll summary.

sections.heading: Accounts and server data
paragraphs: RNGdle uses Supabase for optional account authentication. If you create an account, Supabase stores the email address used for sign-in and the display name you provide.
RNGdle does not currently upload roll results, run a global leaderboard, or publish user profiles. Gameplay scores remain local to the browser.
